property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the TextPreference (a Application or Document).

property.name: events
property.shortdesc: A collection of events.

property.name: eventListeners
property.shortdesc: A collection of event listeners.

property.name: typographersQuotes
property.shortdesc: If true, converts straight quotes to typographic quotes.

property.name: highlightHjViolations
property.shortdesc: If true, highlights hyphenation and justification rule violations in the text.

property.name: highlightKeeps
property.shortdesc: If true, highlights paragraphs that violate keep options.

property.name: highlightSubstitutedGlyphs
property.shortdesc: If true, highlights substituted glyphs.

property.name: highlightCustomSpacing
property.shortdesc: If true, highlights custom kerned or tracked characters.

property.name: highlightSubstitutedFonts
property.shortdesc: If true, highlights missing fonts.

property.name: useOpticalSize
property.shortdesc: If true, automatically selects the correct optical size.

property.name: useParagraphLeading
property.shortdesc: If true, applies the leading changes made to a text range to the entire paragraph. If false, applies leading changes only to the text range.

property.name: superscriptSize
property.shortdesc: The size of superscript characters, specified as a percentage of the font size. (Range: 0 to 200)

property.name: superscriptPosition
property.shortdesc: The position of superscript characters, specified as a percentage of the regular leading. (Range: -500 to 500)

property.name: subscriptSize
property.shortdesc: The size of subscript characters, specified as a percentage of the font size. (Range: 0 to 200)

property.name: subscriptPosition
property.shortdesc: The position of subscript characters, specified as a percentage of the regular leading. (Range: -500 to 500)

property.name: smallCap
property.shortdesc: The size of text formatted as small caps, specified as a percentage of the font size. (Range: 1 to 200)

property.name: leadingKeyIncrement
property.shortdesc: The amount that leading increases each time the user presses the option/alt-up arrow keys or decreases each time the user presses the option/alt-down arrow keys. (Range: .001 to 100)

property.name: baselineShiftKeyIncrement
property.shortdesc: The amount that the baseline shift increases each time the user presses the option/alt-shift-up arrow keys or decreases each time the user presses the option/alt-shift-down arrow keys. (Range: .001 to 100)

property.name: kerningKeyIncrement
property.shortdesc: The amount the kerning value per 1000 ems increases each time the user presses of the option/alt-right arrow keys or decreases each time the user presses the option/alt-left arrow keys. (Range: 1 to 100)

property.name: showInvisibles
property.shortdesc: If true, shows hidden characters.

property.name: justifyTextWraps
property.shortdesc: If true, justifies text around text wrap objects.

property.name: abutTextToTextWrap
property.shortdesc: If true, moves wrapped text to the next available leading increment below the text wrap objects (skip by leading).

property.name: zOrderTextWrap
property.shortdesc: If true, text wrap does not affect text on layers above the layer that contains the text wrap object. If false, text wrap affects text on all visible layers.

property.name: linkTextFilesWhenImporting
property.shortdesc: If true, links placed text files and spreadsheet files. If false, embeds the files.

property.name: highlightKinsoku
property.shortdesc: If true, uses on-screen highlighting to identify kinsoku.

property.name: quoteCharactersRotatedInVertical
property.shortdesc: If true, Japanese composer treats quotes as half width and rotates them in vertical.

property.name: smartTextReflowSync
property.shortdesc: If this is True, and if Smart text reflow is also enabled, then this will synchronously add/delete pages after text reflowing

property.name: shapeIndicAndLatinWithHarbuzz
property.shortdesc: If this bool is set to true, shaping of Indic & Latin characters will be done through Harfbuzz Shaping engine, instead of Lipika.

property.name: useNewVerticalScaling
property.shortdesc: If true, reverses X and Y scaling on Roman characters in vertical text.

property.name: useCidMojikumi
property.shortdesc: If true, uses the glyph CID to get the mojikumi class of the character.

property.name: honourTextIndentsWithTextWrap
property.shortdesc: If true, modifies indentation for Bulleted Paragraph and Bullets around a Text Wrap object.

property.name: enableStylePreviewMode
property.shortdesc: If true, highlights character and paragraph styles with colored backgrounds.

property.name: smartTextReflow
property.shortdesc: If true, enable automatic adding and deleting of pages in response to text reflow.

property.name: addPages
property.shortdesc: Specifies where to insert new pages in response to overset text.

property.name: limitToMasterTextFrames
property.shortdesc: Restrict the adding of pages during smart text reflow to overridden master text frames.

property.name: preserveFacingPageSpreads
property.shortdesc: Preserve left-hand and right-and pages when facing pages are enabled during smart text reflow.

property.name: deleteEmptyPages
property.shortdesc: Enable auto-deletion of pages containing empty threaded text frames.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the TextPreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
